$comment: Canonical design tokens for AppGen-X. The Python generator (pyAppGen.design_tokens), the generated app's stylesheet, and the Studio all read this file so the three cannot drift. Palette values are per-theme; every other group is theme-independent.

focus_ring.$comment: Rendered as `0 0 0 {spread}px rgba(r, g, b, {alpha})` from the theme's primary colour. fallback is used when the primary is not a six-digit hex.

surface_detail.$comment: Theme-independent neutrals for card edges and raised surfaces. The per-theme background lives in palette.surface.

state.$comment: Translucent interaction washes are literal rgba rather than palette-derived, matching the shipped stylesheet.

breakpoint.$comment: Mobile collapse point for the generated layout.
